extraction.name: VQAonline
extraction.description: A fully authentic Visual Question Answering dataset sourced from online question answering community forums (Stack Exchange). The dataset contains visual questions, images, context, and answers validated by the individuals who asked the questions. It spans 105 diverse topics across five super-categories: culture & recreation, life & arts, science, professional, and business.
extraction.creator: Chongyan Chen, Mengchen Liu, Noel Codella, Yunsheng Li, Lu Yuan, Danna Gurari
extraction.publisher: University of Texas at Austin, Microsoft, University of Colorado Boulder
extraction.citeAs: Chen, C., Liu, M., Codella, N., Li, Y., Yuan, L., & Gurari, D. (2024). Fully Authentic Visual Question Answering Dataset from Online Communities. arXiv:2311.15562v4 [cs.CV]
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data was collected by scraping publicly-available data from the Stack Exchange online question-answering platform spanning from August 2010 to November 2022. Each example contains a natural language question (collected as post 'title'), a natural language context (collected via 'body' text entry field), an image (collected as URL link), and at least one answer. Individuals who posted visual questions could mark which answer was the 'accepted answer'; only examples with accepted answers were included.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Stack Exchange platform data from 105 topical sites across five super-categories: 46 about culture & recreation, 25 about life & arts, 24 about science, 7 about being professional, and 3 about business. The platform has stringent reputation system with moderation policies and topic-specific sites for users to engage with relevant communities.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Two filtering steps were conducted: (1) Removed low-quality VQAs based on Stack Exchange's voting feature - excluded visual questions with scores 0 or less for either the question or answer. (2) Excluded visual questions with multiple images (e.g., GIF) or with visual answers. All images were converted to png format for consistency. Final dataset contains 64,696 VQAs after filtering and removing examples where images could not be downloaded.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Answers were provided by Stack Exchange users and validated by the individuals who asked the questions through the 'accepted answer' mechanism. For user intention annotation, three crowdworkers from Amazon Mechanical Turk annotated 105 examples (one from each topic) into eight categories: instruction, evidence, verification, advice, identification, opinion, reason, and other. Workers received one-on-one Zoom training and passed a qualifying test. Two independent annotations were collected per VQA, with a third worker breaking ties when annotations didn't match (25 out of 105 cases).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Stack Exchange platform for original answers; Amazon Mechanical Turk for user intention annotations
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: For user intention annotations, agreement accuracy improved from 53.3% to 87.5% and Cohen's kappa agreement improved from 45.24% to 84.69% across four rounds of refinement. The mean number of answers per visual question is 1.45. Community deliberation occurred through users posting comments under questions or answers, and individuals could propose edits to existing answers which had to be approved by high-reputation users.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: Mean of 1.45 answers per visual question on Stack Exchange. For user intention study: 2-3 crowdworker annotations per VQA (105 examples total)
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: For user intention annotations: Three crowdworkers from Amazon Mechanical Turk, located in the United States, with more than 500 completed HITs and over 95% approval rating. For human evaluation study: Ten domain experts with at least a Master's degree in fields related to their assigned VQA topics (Physical Fitness, Botany, Music, Mechanics, Politics, Law, Chinese Language, Economics, Statistics, and Artificial Intelligence).
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: DeepSolo text spotter model was used to detect text presence in images, finding that 76% (48,161 images) contain text.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Dataset is publicly shared at https://vqaonline.github.io/. The dataset contains training, validation, and test splits of 665, 285, and 63,746 examples respectively. Training and validation splits were created by randomly selecting 7 examples for training and 3 examples for validation from each of the 105 topics with at least 20 examples.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset spans 105 topics across diverse domains including culture, religion (e.g., Christianity, Hinduism, Mi Yodeya), languages (e.g., French, Chinese, Russian), and geographic contexts. VQAs are posted by Stack Exchange users with access to mobile devices and Internet, which may poorly represent people in poverty-stricken areas. Geographic representation is unbalanced, with more representation from countries like US, India, and Europe, and less from countries like Egypt.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset can benefit real-world applications including community question answering platforms (e.g., Yahoo! Answers, Wiki Answers, Quora), learning assistance VQA tools for children, virtual assistants, visual dialog and query, as well as visual search and browsing. The dataset addresses limitations of artificially-constructed VQA datasets by providing fully authentic content from real use cases.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset may poorly represent people in poverty-stricken areas since VQAs are posted by Stack Exchange users with access to mobile devices and Internet. Geographic representation is unbalanced with more representation from US, India, and Europe. The dataset shows 76% of images contain text, with 79-84% being screenshots, reflecting users' tendency to ask questions about the digital realm. Models trained on Stack Exchange data (including potentially the benchmarked models) may have unfair advantages.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Only 65.7% of images are necessary for answering questions based on manual analysis of 105 examples per topic. The dataset's lengthy answers (mean of 173 words) are incompatible with standard VQA evaluation metrics designed for short responses. The dataset is constrained to Stack Exchange users and may not generalize to other populations. Some topics have as few as 10 examples while others have over 20,000, showing imbalanced distribution. Models may have been exposed to Stack Exchange data during training, bringing potential data contamination issues.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Dataset use cases include Training, Testing, and Validation for VQA models. The dataset supports few-shot learning with dedicated training and validation splits. It is designed for developing VQA models that can handle authentic use cases with lengthy, detailed answers and supplementary context. The dataset is particularly suited for evaluating models on information-seeking questions requiring domain-specific knowledge across 105 diverse topics.
